testimonials.name: Bob and Heidi
testimonials.quote: Seth completely transformed the flower beds around our house by adding paver borders and stone. Not only is he extremely personable and trustworthy, he is meticulous and has great attention to detail. He exceeded our expectations, and we would highly recommend him.

testimonials.name: Dan and Kathy
testimonials.quote: Seth is a true artisan and master of his craft. Anyone can go to a store to buy stones and mortar. But the ability to take a vision and implement it with impeccable detail and craftsmanship is what you get when you deal with Cape Fear Stone. We would recommend Seth to anyone who is serious about making an upscale improvement to the outside of their home.

testimonials.name: Terri and Maria
testimonials.quote: We are thrilled with our new patio! Seth did a beautiful job and paid close attention to every detail. He was professional, meticulous, and very reasonably priced. The finished patio exceeded our expectations, and we highly recommend him for any landscaping project.
